raw.rationale: This is a multi-kinase inhibitor with potent activity against FLT3, KIT, PDGFRA/B, RET, and CSF1R, so selective killing is most plausible in lineages with strong oncogenic dependence on these kinases, especially FLT3-mutant AML (not listed) and KIT/PDGFRA-driven GIST or RET-driven tumors; among the listed lineages, only a few have recurrent such dependencies, and PRISM single-concentration data generally show low lineage selectivity rates.
